name: com.chinamedscheck/mcp
title: ChinaMedsCheck — China Customs GACC Medication Legality & Airport Red-Channel Engine
description: Screen 38 medications against China Customs GACC rules, CAAC limits & airport desks.

tools.name: screen_medication_gacc_customs_legality
tools.description: Match prescription brands, active ingredients, CAS numbers, RxNorm CUIs, Chinese names, or Russian/Japanese/Korean/Vietnamese aliases against 38 regulated entries under GACC Decree 442.

medicationQuery.description: Brand name, generic ingredient, Chinese name, CAS number, or slug (e.g., "Adderall", "Concerta", "Xanax", "CBD oil", "Ozempic", or "all").

statusFilter.description: Optional severity filter when listing or narrowing results (RED banned, YELLOW controlled, GREEN allowed).

tools.name: calculate_medication_supply_allowance
tools.description: Compute whether carried medication quantities fall within legal Class I psychotropic (7-day), Class II (15-day), or maintenance prescription (90-day) caps relative to trip length.

medicationQuery.description: Drug brand, slug, generic name, or fallback class ("GENERIC_BANNED", "GENERIC_CAT1", "GENERIC_CAT2", "GENERIC_MAINTENANCE_RX", "GENERIC_OTC").

carriedSupplyDays.description: Total days of medication dosage the traveler intends to pack across China Customs.

stayDurationDays.description: Total planned stay length inside Mainland China in calendar days.

tools.name: evaluate_caac_cabin_sharps_and_cold_chain
tools.description: Inspect Civil Aviation Administration of China cabin rules for insulin pens, EpiPen auto-injectors, medical needles, refrigerated cold packs, and doctor certificate requirements.

medicationQuery.description: Specific injectable or biologic medication name/slug (e.g., "Ozempic", "Insulin", "EpiPen") or pass "all" to filter by equipment flag.

filterMode.description: Filter dataset by syringe/needle involvement, cold-chain refrigeration, or mandatory airline medical certificate.

tools.name: generate_bilingual_china_pharmacy_card
tools.description: Produce printable simplified Mandarin doctor/pharmacist consultation notes, Pinyin pronunciation, domestic brand equivalents, and customs officer show-card fields for travelers in China.

medicationQuery.description: Medication brand name, generic drug, or slug (e.g., "Ibuprofen", "Tylenol", "Adderall", "Concerta", "Claritin").

passengerName.description: Optional traveler full passport name to prefill the English/Chinese declaration slip header.

daysOfSupply.description: Optional declared supply duration in days for customs paperwork formatting.

tools.name: check_china_hospital_refill_and_clinic_pathway
tools.description: Determine if a foreign prescription can be legally re-prescribed inside Chinese Tier-3 hospitals or expat clinics, listing required department specialists, max refill days, and documentation.

medicationQuery.description: Drug brand, generic substance, or slug (e.g., "Concerta", "Xanax", "Metformin", "Prozac") or pass "refillable_only".

tools.name: audit_multi_medication_travel_bag_manifest
tools.description: Evaluate an entire packed toiletry or travel bag containing multiple medications simultaneously to pinpoint any single banned trigger, aggregate Red Channel duties, and prepare a customs manifest.

bagItems.description: List of medications inside traveler luggage along with packed day quantities.

medicationQuery.description: Brand name, generic ingredient, or slug of a packed medication.

carriedSupplyDays.description: Number of daily doses packed in luggage for this item.

stayDurationDays.description: Planned Mainland China visit duration in days used to cross-check long-stay refills.

tools.name: query_airport_red_channel_meds_walkthrough
tools.description: Look up customs pre-inspection CT lock procedures, exact Red Channel declaration counters, operating hours, and arrival baggage steps across PVG, PEK, CAN, and PKX international airports.

airportQuery.description: Airport IATA code (PVG, PEK, CAN, PKX), city name (Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou), terminal slug, or "all".

locale.description: Language code for localized arrival instructions (defaults to English).

tools.name: lookup_therapeutic_substitute_mesh
tools.description: Traverse the curated 38-drug therapeutic similarity graph to surface legal Chinese-approved substitutes and side-by-side risk comparisons when a traveler’s primary prescription is prohibited or heavily restricted.

medicationQuery.description: Target banned or restricted medication (e.g., "Adderall", "CBD oil", "Codeine", "Modafinil") to find safer clinical alternatives.
